_readme.overview: Two triggers: (1) Daily 7 AM cron checks all open items for approaching filing deadlines (30/14/7 days) and sends RingCentral alerts. (2) Monday.com webhook on status change handles escalation routing (Fully Insured → NY DFS, ERISA → Federal review) and auto-moves Won/Lost items to Resolved group.
setup_steps: 1. Import this workflow into your n8n instance
2. All credentials are injected via PM2 env vars — no n8n credential UI needed
3. Set MONDAY_API_TOKEN and RINGCENTRAL_WEBHOOK_DENIALS in ecosystem.config.js
4. In Monday.com board settings, create a webhook that fires on Appeal Status changes and points to this workflow's Status Change webhook URL
5. Activate the workflow — cron will run daily at 7 AM

escalation_paths.fully_insured: NY DFS External Appeal — 120 days, $25 fee, binding 30-day review
escalation_paths.self_funded_erisa: Federal External Review via IRO — 120 days, binding on plan
